request: 모든 공식 휴무일은 사용자가 설정한 한국천문연구원(KASI) API의 isHoliday=Y 응답만을 기준으로 판정한다. 계산·다른 캘린더로 휴무일을 보충하지 말고, 그 외 동기화 동작은 변경하지 않는다.
requirements: Only successful KASI API isHoliday=Y data or its KASI-derived cache sets official day-off status and name.
No API key, network/API failure, invalid response, or not-yet-loaded year means unknown/no official holiday; never substitute computations or other calendars.
A valid empty KASI response is distinct from a not-yet-loaded response and establishes no day-offs for that year.
Synced holiday duplicate filtering only hides a provider copy when KASI confirms the corresponding date; preserve personal and unknown events.
No unrelated calendar sync behavior, native platform code, or deployment changes.
